What is FDV?
FDV means Fully Diluted Valuation. It is calculated by multiplying the token price by the total token supply. For $DGW: $0.0001 × 1,000,000,000 = $100,000 FDV. This represents the theoretical market cap if every token were in circulation at the planned starting price.
$DGW is the utility token planned for the Degen Wars ecosystem. It will be used for cosmetics, marketplace activity, tournaments, seasonal rewards, and future Web3 features.
Token details are planned and may change before official launch. $DGW is designed as a utility token for the Degen Wars game ecosystem.
